section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study examining the psychometric properties of the Persian Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2) in Iran. The study included 568 men and 525 women recruited from seven universities in Tehran, with participants analyzed separately by gender. The Persian BAS-2 demonstrated adequate psychometric properties with a one-factor solution similar to the original English version.
